props.name: bulkActions
props.comment: Enable row selection + the bulk-actions toolbar (also on if a `#bulkActions` slot is passed).

props.name: rowClick
props.comment:
What a row click does: `"edit"` (default), `"show"`, `"expand"`,
`"toggleSelection"`, `false` (inert), or a function of `(record, id)`
returning one of those or any other link type (`false` = do nothing).

props.name: expandSingle
props.comment: Allow only one expanded row at a time (also hides the expand-all button).

props.name: isRowExpandable
props.comment: Which records can expand; a rejected row gets no toggle. All can by default.

props.name: rowClass
props.type: ((record: TRecord, rowIndex: number) => string | false | undefined)
props.comment: A class for a body row, computed from its record and index.

props.name: storeKey
props.comment:
The store key of the hidden column ids; the order and the published
columns are kept under keys derived from it. Defaults to
`"<resource>.datatable"`.

props.name: defaultHiddenColumns
props.comment: Column ids hidden until a choice is stored.

slots.name: expand
slots.type: { id: Identifier; record: TRecord; resource: string; }
slots.comment: Under an expanded row, given the row's record.
